policy: These identities are baseline analytic/numerical diagnostics under their stated smoothness, boundary and forcing assumptions. Passing them does not establish global regularity; failing them in a numerical run may indicate discretization or implementation error before it indicates continuum pathology.

identities.name: Incompressibility constraint
identities.phase2_diagnostic: Track divergence norms and projection residuals; significant growth is a solver-validity warning, not evidence of physical singularity.

identities.name: Three-dimensional Navier-Stokes scaling
identities.statement: If (u,p) solves the unforced equations, then u_lambda(x,t)=lambda u(lambda x, lambda^2 t) and p_lambda(x,t)=lambda^2 p(lambda x, lambda^2 t) solve the correspondingly scaled equations.
identities.phase2_diagnostic: Use scaling dimensions to classify candidate norms and to catch dimensionally inconsistent diagnostics.

identities.name: Smooth unforced kinetic-energy equality
identities.phase2_diagnostic: Compare discrete energy change with viscous dissipation and report balance residual; a residual is a numerical diagnostic, not a proof of or against singularity.

identities.name: Vorticity evolution
identities.statement: partial_t omega + (u dot grad)omega = (omega dot grad)u + nu Delta omega + curl f, where omega=curl u
identities.phase2_diagnostic: Separate advection, vortex stretching, viscous diffusion and forcing contributions; do not infer blow-up from large stretching alone.

identities.name: Smooth unforced enstrophy balance
identities.statement: (1/2)d/dt ||omega||_L2^2 + nu ||grad omega||_L2^2 = integral omega_i partial_i u_j omega_j dx
identities.phase2_diagnostic: Track enstrophy, palinstrophy/dissipation and vortex-stretching production with a balance residual; loss of discrete balance is first a numerical warning.

identities.name: Pressure Poisson relation
identities.statement: -Delta p = partial_i partial_j (u_i u_j) - div f; for divergence-free forcing this reduces to -Delta p = partial_i partial_j (u_i u_j)
identities.phase2_diagnostic: Check pressure reconstruction residual against the velocity field and forcing convention used by the solver.
